title: Cod & Potatoes
description: Portuguese-inspired one-pan dish of flaked cod, pan-fried potatoes and onion finished with whole eggs — simple, hearty and high-protein.
steps: Cut potatoes into small cubes; microwave in a container at 600W for 5–6 minutes.
Cut cod into bite-sized pieces. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Fry potatoes in oil on medium-high 5–6 minutes. Add onion with more oil; fry 3 minutes.
Add cod; season and fry 3–5 minutes until cooked through. Mash cod into the potato mixture.
Pour in eggs; stir until cooked.
notes: If no microwave, cook potatoes in the pan on medium-low for 15 minutes before adding onion.
